name: send_shared_draft
title: Send shared draft
description: Send the shared draft of a ticket as it is saved, as an agent sends it in Zammad: its type, recipients, subject and text, in reply to the message it answers, with the group's email signature. Zammad deletes the draft once it is sent. get_shared_draft reads it first. Where supported the client must confirm the complete prepared message. Otherwise use client tool approval. A draft with files, ticket field changes, or signing or encryption is refused: an agent sends it from Zammad. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.

ticket_number.description: The ticket number as shown in Zammad, e.g. "31042" or "Ticket#31042".

ticket_id.description: The internal ID of the ticket, e.g. 8812.

ticket_url.description: A link to the ticket in Zammad.

time_unit.description: The time the user says they spent, where Zammad accounts time; never an estimate.

skip_time_accounting.description: true once the user said they account no time for this message, as Zammad's Skip does. Never on your own.
